rights_basis: Bounded received English on ordinary numbered Lasance/Walsh 1945-edition pages 1265-1268, under the registration-specific United States nonrenewal basis in src/sources/inventories/lasance-new-roman-missal-rights-v1.toml. text: The souls of the just are in the hand of God, and the torment of malice shall not touch them: in the sight of the unwise they seemed to die, but they are in peace. Alleluia.
